purpose: Define a low-cost incremental prospective E-layer update model that consumes only newly observed official disclosures after the last successful watermark instead of rescanning historical CNInfo windows.
activation_prerequisites: V2.8.4 official PDF materialization validation PASS
V2.8.4 PDF text extraction validation PASS
bounded real official evidence diagnostic completes with at least one successful filing

problem_elimination.avoid: No repeated PDF materialization for an already-seen announcement_id/object_sha256.
problem_elimination.absorb: Use the frozen 18-term candidate collector and content-addressed PDF cache.
problem_elimination.substitute: Maintain one append-only announcement watermark ledger.
problem_elimination.precompute_reuse: Persist announcement_id, first_observed_at, canonical security identity, object SHA, extraction SHA and decision SHA.
problem_elimination.optimize: Only unseen announcement IDs proceed to materialization and classification.

incremental_watermark.authority: GitHub committed_at of the append-only E-layer observation receipt
incremental_watermark.new_revision_or_new_announcement_id: may create a new evidence event

daily_scan.window_policy: Scan a short overlap window sufficient to tolerate CNInfo indexing latency; dedup by announcement_id makes overlap harmless.

eligibility_transition.positive_evidence_event: May establish ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE prospectively only from the first trading session permitted by the frozen observation-time rule.
eligibility_transition.exclusion_or_not_established_event: Does not erase older valid positive evidence without a separately defined revocation rule.
eligibility_transition.revocation_logic: NOT_DEFINED_IN_V2_8_4; fail closed and retain prior positive state until a later version explicitly freezes revocation semantics.

forbidden: No rescanning all historical filings every day.
No changing the 18-term registry from live outcomes.
No retroactive eligibility before authoritative observation.
No automatic revocation based on missing candidate hits.
